verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs say it sends webhooks to tell you about changes to Items (connection state) and asynchronous processes, and that Transactions stays up to date via webhooks. That covers the core push-instead-of-polling workflow for transactions and connection changes. Missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed or verifiable, evidence of balance-update webhooks (Balance is described only as real-time retrieval), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
